title: TAT-3687 — perps-controller v11 adoption, no regression
description: Proves Mobile resolves @metamask/perps-controller 11.x, that every v11 breaking change is fixed (repo type-checks clean and the widened OrderType / PerpsErrorCode adoption is unit-covered), and that the Perps market-order, limit-order, Auto close, close-position, and full open/close lifecycle flows still work against the new controller.

status.intent: Read runner compatibility status before asserting anything

assert-declared-version.intent: C1: confirm Mobile declares the v11 perps-controller range

assert-resolved-version.intent: C1: confirm the declared range actually resolves to 11.0.0, so every later node runs against v11

typecheck.intent: C2: compile the repo against v11 — this is the node that fails if any breaking-change fix is removed

assert-typecheck-clean.intent: C2: assert zero TypeScript errors, proving every v11 breaking change is fixed

unit-tests.intent: C3: exercise the widened OrderType and PerpsErrorCode adoption behaviourally, not just at the type level

assert-unit-tests-pass.intent: C3: assert the error-code map, maker-status, toast-bucket and close-position behaviour is correct under v11

prove-market-order.intent: C4: place a real ETH market order with take profit and stop loss through the Mobile UI, exercising the order form, fee hook, TP/SL route params and order toasts against v11

prove-limit-order.intent: C5: place a real ETH limit order through the Mobile UI, exercising the limit branch of the fee hook and the limit order toasts against v11

prove-auto-close.intent: C6: update an open ETH position's Auto close settings through the Mobile UI, exercising updatePositionTPSL and the TP/SL form against v11

prove-close-position.intent: C7: close an ETH position through the Mobile UI, exercising v11's reduce-only size-grid rounding and the removed $10-minimum retry

prove-lifecycle.intent: C8: run the full open, verify, close and teardown lifecycle end to end against v11
